title: Negation Beyond the Verbal Channel: Temporal Multimodal Correlates in Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2609.16396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Negation is typically modeled through its linguistic realization, although spoken interaction is accompanied by tightly coordinated nonverbal behavior. We ask whether contexts centered on spoken negation cues contain measurable multimodal behavioral information: whether they can be distinguished from matched control contexts without lexical or acoustic input, where this information occurs in time, which modalities carry it, and whether it extends to the dialogue partner. We study 27 human-human interviews conducted in virtual reality, comprising temporally aligned gaze, facial, head, body, hand, and finger behavior and 964 annotated negation cues. Treating classification as a predictive probe, we compare 20 time-series models while excluding lexical and acoustic information, and then systematically vary temporal context, interactional source, modality availability, and event timing. translated_title: 否定超越言语通道：对话中的时序多模态关联
translated_abstract: 否定通常通过其语言实现形式来建模，尽管口语交流伴随着紧密协调的非言语行为。我们探讨以口语否定线索为中心的语境是否包含可测量的多模态行为信息：在排除词汇和声学输入的情况下，这些语境能否与匹配的对照语境区分开来，这些信息在时间上出现在何处，哪些模态承载了这些信息，以及这些信息是否延伸至对话伙伴。我们研究了27场在虚拟现实中进行的人人访谈，包含时间对齐的注视、面部、头部、身体、手部和手指行为数据，以及964个标注的否定线索。我们将分类任务作为预测性探针，在排除词汇和声学信息的前提下比较了20个时间序列模型，随后系统地改变时间上下文、互动来源、模态可用性和事件时机等因素。在分组10折交叉验证中，最强的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过虚拟现实中27场人人访谈的多模态数据，在完全排除词汇和声学信息的前提下，利用20个时间序列模型证明口语否定线索在注视、面部、头部、身体等非言语通道中存在可测量的时序关联，且这些信息还能延伸至对话伙伴。
en_tdlr: Using 27 VR-based human-human interviews and 20 time-series models while excluding lexical and acoustic input, this study demonstrates that spoken negation cues carry measurable temporal multimodal behavioral correlates across gaze, facial, head, and body channels, extending even to the dialogue partner.
